fields.old: Record kv40 Missing; open question 'KV40 and CCS are not reported in the reviewed source specifications' (source files DL2-13944.pdf, DL2-12648.pdf, DL2-12173.pdf). DL2-13944.pdf prints 'Kinematic Viscosity @ 400C | ASTM D445 | cSt | Report' and DL2-12173.pdf prints '-' for 'Viscosity @ 40° c'.
fields.form: SDS reported value; statistical basis unspecified (Luberef SDS section 9); single value with temperature
fields.reason: The SDS prints a single KV40 value with its temperature and unit, so the record's statement that KV40 is 'not reported' in DL2-12648.pdf is wrong (the earlier review missed the line). No technical document gives a KV40 value (one prints 'Report', the other '-'). Under CLAUDE.md data rule 2 the applicable SDS value is then the candidate for selection, but selection belongs to tools/data_policy/source_selection.py and is not made in this review, and the review's own rule forbids proposing an SDS value of unspecified basis as an added value. Propose correcting the open question: quote '476,2 mm²/s (40 °C)' (decimal comma as printed; method not printed; SDS class, statistical basis unspecified) as the only printed KV40 for this grade and flag it for the source-selection decision. CCS remains not reported. kv40 stays Missing here.

fields.form: SDS reported value; statistical basis unspecified (Luberef SDS section 9); single value, no method
fields.reason: Comparability checked: same property and unit; the SDS prints no method (the specification is COC), a single value of unstated basis against a specification minimum, and the editions differ (SDS 2021; specification sheet undated). 168 lies below the minimum 175, but with the method unknown and the value classes different this is not called a direct conflict. Propose an SDS alternate entry with the missing method stated, and an open question to Luberef; the specification minimum stays selected.
